subject: Westside Watch homepage — first real design pass
body: Modify the EXISTING Penpot board with id fca4e052-7a4d-80fd-8008-8f9d0e6b9771. Do not create another test board. This is the first real Westside Watch homepage design iteration. Inspect the current board first, then improve it into a mature editorial/church-cultural homepage composition. Preserve editable native Penpot layers. Keep Living Paper #FAF9F5 and Ink Black #252525 dominant; First Light Gold #A2872A is restrained structural emphasis; Watch Night #102A43 is a purposeful visual field, not generic decoration. Rework hierarchy and proportions: masthead and navigation should feel deliberate and quiet; hero must gain strong editorial scale and breathing room; the 5:8 visual field must participate in the page architecture rather than look like a standalone rectangle; the Chinese feature area should become a real editorial module; rules and spacing should establish a coherent grid. Avoid SaaS cards, rounded UI panels, decorative gold overload, and generic template aesthetics. Typography intent: Cormorant Garamond for English display/editorial hierarchy and Noto Serif TC for Chinese; if exact font assignment is unavailable, preserve the hierarchy and report the limitation rather than inventing success. Export the exact modified board as PNG and run visual verification. Return exact board id, child count if available, what was changed, and verification evidence. Do not report completion without actual mutation plus rendered evidence.
design_brief: Westside Watch should feel like a quiet, intelligent, architectural Christian editorial publication at dawn: Living Paper, Ink, restrained First Light Gold, purposeful Watch Night, asymmetry, generous whitespace, fine rules, strong 5:8 relationships, and a sense of light entering an ordered stone/paper structure. This is no longer a capability test. Make a visibly better first design pass on the existing homepage board.
